topic: Compilation of awkward and crazy public encounters of Zlatan Ibrahimović with fans, haters and stunts, mixing old match clips and street videos
hook: Bald bearded man with yellow arrow label 'HATER', then car interior with 'STREAMER' label; narrator lists crazy moments
subtitle_style: short white caps labels with yellow hand-drawn arrows (HATER, STREAMER, HEY); lower-third white captions with black outline ('We're gonna get you.', 'ITS GONNA GET UGLY BACK HOME!')
reaction_overlays: hand-drawn yellow arrows, name labels, split-screen reaction cuts, photo-in-frame inserts, blurred faces, Nost FC watermark bottom centre
transition_summary: Very fast hard cuts, flash/split-screen swaps and 0.2s burst cuts (about 6.5 cuts/10s, 40 cuts in 60s); mix of whip-like cuts and picture-frame insert
audio_note: English documentary-style voice-over ('From getting death threats because of a celebration to having his most awkward situation ever...') plus original clip audio

reuse_segments.what: Street/fan encounter clips (phone and TV footage) mixed with archival matches
reuse_segments.how_to_reuse: Third-party clips; recreate with generated imagery or own staged sketch; reuse caption/arrow label style only
